scenes.tts: If maturing inhibition opens the window, what closes it? Does the machinery for change simply wear out?
scenes.visual: Title card: Brakes, and Borrowed Cells. The band on the timeline ends; a question mark at its edge.
scenes.narration: If maturing inhibition opens the window, what closes it? Does the machinery for change simply wear out?

scenes.tts: If so, removing one molecule in an adult should not bring the window back.
scenes.visual: Two cartoons: worn-out machinery versus machinery held by a brake.
scenes.narration: If so, removing one molecule in an adult should not bring the window back.

scenes.tts: As the window ends, a lattice of matrix called a perineuronal net condenses around many parvalbumin cells.
scenes.visual: A parvalbumin cell gathers a lattice net around its cell body.
scenes.narration: As the window ends, a lattice of matrix called a perineuronal net condenses around many parvalbumin cells.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. Digest that net in an adult rat, then close one eye. Does the cortex shift?
scenes.visual: Predict card: adult rat, net digested, one eye closed. Shift or not?
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. Digest that net in an adult rat, then close one eye. Does the cortex shift?

scenes.tts: It does. Chondroitinase, an enzyme that cuts the net's sugar chains, let deprivation shift adult rat cortex.
scenes.visual: Chondroitinase ABC dissolves the net; the adult band reopens. Credit: Pizzorusso and colleagues, 2002.
scenes.narration: It does. Chondroitinase, an enzyme that cuts the net's sugar chains, let deprivation shift adult rat cortex.

scenes.tts: Myelin carries proteins such as Nogo. Mice lacking the Nogo receptor kept plasticity past the usual closing age.
scenes.visual: A myelin strip with Nogo; the receptor removed; the band stretches past its usual end. Credit: McGee and colleagues, 2005.
scenes.narration: Myelin carries proteins such as Nogo. Mice lacking the Nogo receptor kept plasticity past the usual closing age.

scenes.tts: Lynx one is a small membrane protein that damps nicotinic receptors. Adult mice without it kept strong plasticity.
scenes.caption: Lynx1 is a small membrane protein that damps nicotinic receptors. Adult mice without it kept strong plasticity.
scenes.visual: A Lynx1 tag on a nicotinic receptor; then removed, and the adult band stays open. Credit: Morishita and colleagues, 2010.
scenes.narration: Lynx1 is a small membrane protein that damps nicotinic receptors. Adult mice without it kept strong plasticity.

scenes.tts: Blocking nicotinic receptors prevented that plasticity.
scenes.visual: A nicotinic blocker added; the band closes.
scenes.narration: Blocking nicotinic receptors prevented that plasticity.

scenes.tts: Inhibition itself has a second job. Past the threshold, it keeps maturing and becomes a brake.
scenes.visual: An inhibition gauge rises past the opening line and keeps rising toward a brake zone.
scenes.narration: Inhibition itself has a second job. Past the threshold, it keeps maturing and becomes a brake.

scenes.tts: In adult rats, reducing gaba transmission partly restored plasticity.
scenes.caption: In adult rats, reducing GABA transmission partly restored plasticity.
scenes.visual: Adult rat cortex: GABA transmission turned down; a partial band returns. Credit: Harauzov and colleagues, 2010.
scenes.narration: In adult rats, reducing GABA transmission partly restored plasticity.

scenes.tts: In adult rats, weeks of the antidepressant fluoxetine lowered inhibition and restored plasticity. Diazepam blocked that.
scenes.visual: Fluoxetine lowers the gauge and the band reopens; diazepam added, and it closes. Credit: Maya Vetencourt and colleagues, 2008.
scenes.narration: In adult rats, weeks of the antidepressant fluoxetine lowered inhibition and restored plasticity. Diazepam blocked that.

scenes.tts: In the knockout, diazepam opened the window. In the adult, it put the brake back.
scenes.visual: Split screen: knockout, diazepam opens; adult with fluoxetine, diazepam closes.
scenes.narration: In the knockout, diazepam opened the window. In the adult, it put the brake back.

scenes.tts: Now a direct test of whether the window follows the cells. Transplant embryonic inhibitory neuron precursors into a young mouse's cortex.
scenes.visual: Transplant strip: embryonic medial ganglionic eminence cells picked up and placed into young mouse visual cortex.
scenes.narration: Now a direct test of whether the window follows the cells. Transplant embryonic inhibitory neuron precursors into a young mouse's cortex.

scenes.tts: They mature into interneurons, including parvalbumin cells. The host's own window closes.
scenes.visual: The donor cells disperse and mature; the host's sand band ends.
scenes.narration: They mature into interneurons, including parvalbumin cells. The host's own window closes.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. Will a second window come at the host's age, or at the cells' age?
scenes.visual: Predict card: second window timed by the host, or by the donor cells?
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. Will a second window come at the host's age, or at the cells' age?

scenes.tts: The cells' age. When they reached the age of native interneurons in the normal window, the host shifted again.
scenes.visual: A gold second band appears after the host's sand band. Credit: Southwell and colleagues, 2010.
scenes.narration: The cells' age. When they reached the age of native interneurons in the normal window, the host shifted again.

scenes.tts: Why does this matter? In amblyopia, one eye sees poorly because its input to the cortex was degraded in childhood.
scenes.visual: A child's eyes, one blurred; its input to the cortex drawn faint.
scenes.narration: Why does this matter? In amblyopia, one eye sees poorly because its input to the cortex was degraded in childhood.

scenes.tts: Patching the good eye works best in young children, and much less reliably in adults.
scenes.visual: An eye patch on a child, then on an adult, with a smaller benefit arrow.
scenes.narration: Patching the good eye works best in young children, and much less reliably in adults.

scenes.tts: These rodent results show mechanism, not treatment. Reopening plasticity can also reopen vulnerability.
scenes.visual: Last frame: a rat, not a person, with the words: mechanism, not yet treatment.
scenes.narration: These rodent results show mechanism, not treatment. Reopening plasticity can also reopen vulnerability.

scenes.tts: Takeaway: in rodent visual cortex, this window is set by the state of a circuit, not simply by age. Inhibition opens it, and added brakes, including more mature inhibition, close it.
scenes.visual: Closing card: set by the state of a circuit, not simply by age.
scenes.narration: Takeaway: in rodent visual cortex, this window is set by the state of a circuit, not simply by age. Inhibition opens it, and added brakes, including more mature inhibition, close it.
